actions.name: move_up
actions.title: Move Up
actions.description: Step upward through the current sheet.

actions.name: move_down
actions.title: Move Down
actions.description: Step downward through the current sheet.

actions.name: move_left
actions.title: Move Left
actions.description: Step left through the current sheet.

actions.name: move_right
actions.title: Move Right
actions.description: Step right through the current sheet.

actions.name: wait_turn
actions.title: Wait
actions.description: Hold still for one beat to advance echoes.

actions.name: switch_layer
actions.title: Switch Layer
actions.description: Flip to the matching stitch on another sheet.

actions.name: transfer_object
actions.title: Transfer Parcel
actions.description: Send the facing parcel to a matching spot on another layer.

actions.name: reset_room
actions.title: Reset Room
actions.description: Restart the current route from the initial state.

actions.name: replay_room
actions.title: Replay Route
actions.description: Replay the saved best route or canonical solution.

actions.name: next_room
actions.title: Next Room
actions.description: Cycle to the next unlocked route.

actions.name: prev_room
actions.title: Previous Room
actions.description: Cycle to the previous unlocked route.

notes: Gameplay defaults use the left stick for board movement and the D-Pad for menu navigation.
The manifest is a first-pass reference file for Steam Input setup during Batch 4.
